These checks supplement frozen integrity, leakage, prefix and shortcut checks.

README.md:
# V14 construction candidates

17467 snapshots from 356 authored design proposals. Zero independently approved training rows. Read quality_report.json, the cue diagnostics and annotation_standard.md. Native token coverage, approved D1-D7 GPU smoke/reload and independent challenge validation remain pending.

Exact rebuild, from the project root, to a NEW in-project output path:

```sh
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_context_v14_release.py --authored outputs/context_v14_final_20261025/pack11 --output outputs/a_new_v14_replay
```

All annotations are proposals. The paired category-question histories must be adjudicated separately from actual customer-use histories.
